notes.text: Power-on: an intro (VTS 3 PGC 3) whose one button opens the main menu; Play = b1; then 2D Game (b1) / 3D Game (b2); 2D lands on an in-game PLAY/LEARN signpost (VTS 1 PGC 1 cell 1): b3 = PLAY (cell 39 -> CallSS VMGM pgc 4 -> the game in VTS 2), b6 = LEARN (instructions, back to the sign), doing nothing plays a tutorial of practice moves that also ends at cell 39. Route [1, 1, 1, 3].
notes.why: 2D is the plain picture; the 3D game is the same game for anaglyph glasses.

notes.text: VTS 1 PGC 1 is the tutorial: wrong practice moves play a short clip and carry on, so per-set death learning took the game-start call (pgc 4) for VTS 1's death and keyed LEARN at the sign; the agent looped on it 5 times. The scenarios route past it and skip_keys its windows.
notes.why: A tutorial where nothing kills breaks move_key's premise that wrong options share a death.

play.description: Start a game and make every keyed move as its window arms: every move must land on a right option's next cell, with no death clip before the next move.

play_wrong.description: The control arm of 'play': the same run pressing a WRONG option at every keyed move (move_key pick='wrong'). moves_right must FAIL here, or it cannot tell a death from a survival.
